newsitem.title: USA: California Pro may sell USA Skate business.
newsitem.headline: California Pro may sell USA Skate business.

text.p: California Pro Sports Inc said Thursday it has a non-binding deal to sell the business of its majority owned subsidiary, USA Skate Corp.
The company said the terms being discussed with respect to the possible sale involve the Victoriaville and Vic hockey product lines. The company would not identify the potential buyer.
The due diligence process has already begun, it said. Provided the parties agree to various conditions, the transaction should be completed by late August 1997.

California Pro continues to evaluate options to achieve liquidity, including the feasibility of potential reverse merger candidates, the reduction in the exercise price of its public warrants, and selling or sublicensing its California Pro North American trademark rights for in-line skates.
In regard to the potential merger candidates, the company said that to date no agreements have been reached.

California Pro Sports and its majority owned subsidiary, USA Skate, import, manufacture and distribute products in the sporting goods categories of hockey, in-line skating and snowboarding under the brand names Victoriaville, Vic, McMartin, California Pro, Rolling Thunder and Kemper.
